translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Dos Ponunggelengan Moka-atag to Kodpoka-an diyot Kosaa
Na id itulan dan mandon si Disas to ponunggelengan.
Kahi rin to, “Iddos kodharit Monama, iling ka-ay. Duwon sokkad no hari no id panoy to dakkoon kodpoka-an atag to anak din nod osawa.
To id inguma ron kos allow't kosaa, id po-undiyonnan din to mgo sinuhuwan din iddos mgo minuvun no-inggat amoy od posampot kandan nod undiyon to kosaa. Piru langun dan, id bolivad.

De-en id popiyod din mandon iddos duma pon uripon din amoy od ikahi taddot nongo-inggat no, ‘Nosumbali ron kos mgo baka woy dos id paambog no mgo natin baka, woy nopanoy ron kos langun. De-en undini kowd to kosaa to anak ku.’
Piru iddos nongo-inggat, id podtohon dan da en idda woy id ponayun dan iddos pinuungan dan. Dos sokkad, id undiyon to kamot din woy idda mandad so sokkad, diyot nigusyu rin.
Woy dos duma, id ammot dan moho iddos mgo sinuhuwan taddot hari, id pomodasan dan idda woy id imotayan.
Oray'n nolingasa iddos hari, de-en id polusuran din iddon mgo minuvu to mgo sundau rin amoy'd imotayan dan iddos id imatoy taddot mgo sinuhuwan din woy od tirukkan dos bonuwa ran.
Na id po-umow taddot hari iddos dumon mgo uripon din, kahi rin to, ‘Nopanoy ron kos langun atag to kosaa, piru iddos nongo-inggat ku, konna ollog nod sakup tadda.
Undiyonni row dos mgo minuvu riyot mgo doraanon woy inggata row nod undini to kosaa iddos ahad ondoy nod kokita row.’
De-en id undiyon to doraanon iddos mgo sinuhuwan woy id livuung dan iddos langun no nosuggung dan, dos moppiya woy dos morat no mgo minuvu, woy noponnu iddos baoy nod kosalan.
Todtahad id usok iddos hari amoy'd olit-olit taddot mgo minuvu no nolivuung dutun. Na, nokita rin no duwon sokkad no minuvu no waa id sukub to umpak atag to kosaa.
Id inturan sikandin taddot hari, kahi rin to, ‘Suwod, mambot ka-ay ka no waa ka man id sukub to umpak atag to kosaa?’ Piru waa en sikandin nokotavak.

De-en mid ikahi iddos hari riyot mgo sinuhuwan din to, ‘Bokuwa row kos bollad woy pa-a rin woy lumbag dow sikandin diyot mosuksukirom. Na rutun, mopet dobbo kos sinoggawon din woy'd pogkihot sikandin to ngipon pomon to mosakit nod geddamon din.’ ”
Na mid ikahi si Disas to, “Mo-uraa kos id pon-inggat, piru disok da kos id aam to Monama nod kolonug diyot kodhari rin.”
Dos Intud Moka-atag to Kodbayad to Buhis
Na, mid awa iddos mgo Pariseo woy id pomuhawang dan nod posaharon si Disas ukit to osengan din.

Woy id po-undiyon dan to ki Disas iddos kandan no mgo tinodduwan woy dos mgo minuvu ni Herodes. To kod-inguma ran, id ikohiyan dan si Disas to, “Tohodnonaw, nokosaddoo koy no bonnaa en kos langun nid nonaw ru woy iyon du id nonaw, iddos kovonnaan moka-atag to id kopi-it Monama. Iddos ahad ondoy nod isowwon du, id pod-iling du kos kodnonaw ru kandan, oyyos waa od podmusingon du.
Purisu ponudtuli koy ko ondak poomdom du moka-atag ka-ay. Diyot mgo Suhu ni Moises, ollog bo iddos kodbayad to buhis diyot hari to Roma o dii?”
Piru nosorollan ni Disas no morat kos dontulon dan, de-en kahi rin to, “Sikiyu no oray'd po-uvag-uvag no mopompomakoy, mambot od geddaman a nikiyu?
Pokitanna a ve-en to soopi nid bayad dow to buhis.” Na, id toyawwan dan sikandin to soopi.
Kahin Disas kandan to, “Ondoy man bonnong woy ngaran kos od kokita ka-ay?”
Mid tavak sikandan to, “Iddos hari to Roma.” Na kahin Disas to, “Ko ungketen, boggoy row riyot hari to Roma iddos kandin, woy boggoy row riyot Monama iddos kandin.”
To norinog dan idda, oraroy ran no nosoobbuwan woy mid awa ran dutun woy'd ipanow.
Dos Intud Moka-atag to Kodbadnow taddot id Poomatoy ron
Na iddon allow, duwon mgo Saduseo no id porani ki Disas. Inin mgo minuvu, konnod pomakoy nod bodnawon to Monama iddos id poomatoy ron.

Kahi ran to, “Tohodnonaw, nosulat diyot mgo Suhu ni Moises no otik duwon mama nod patoy no waa anak dan taddot sawa rin, ko-ilangan no od pomoowwon tat suwod din amoy'd poko-anak dan atag taddot id patoy.
Ponunggeleng, duwon pittun toosuwod no mama no id oubpa ka-ay. Dos kinokokayan, id osawa, piru id patoy no waa anak dan. Na, id pomau taddot iko-oruwon suwod din iddon ba-ay.
Ungketen dad en mandad kos notomanan taddot iko-oruwon suwod, woy taddot iko-otollu taman to iko-pittu. Id poomatoy ran langun no waa anak.
Diyot mori, id patoy mandad iddos ba-ay.
Na, init allow to kodbadnow taddot id poomatoy ron, ondoy musing kandan kos tullid no sawa taddot ba-ay? Su iddos langun taddot pittun toosuwod, noko-osawa man kandin.”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Soyup kow, oyyos waa kow nokaabbot taddot Nosulat no Kahit Monama woy taddot kotuusan to Monama.
Su init allow to kodbadnow taddot id poomatoy ron, od poko-iling don sikandan to mgo ponolihan diyot datas to langit no konnod po-osoway.
Na moka-atag to kodbadnow taddot id poomatoy ron, yo row osenga no waa kow nokovasa taddot id ikahi to Monama koniyu no mid ungketen to,

content.text: ‘Siyak kos Monama ni Abraham, ni Isaac woy ni Jacob.’

content: Na, ungketen kos no-ikahi ahad nouhoy ron id poomatoy onsi Abraham. Dos kohulugan tadda, no od kovadnow en iddos poomatoy ron, oyya su iddos Monama, konna sikandin Monama taddot id poomatoy ron, ko konna, Monama taddot nongo-uyag.”
To norinog idda taddot mgo minuvu, oraroy ran no nosoobbuwan taddot nonaw rin.
Dos Intud Moka-atag to Suhu no Lampas to Langun kos Koru-anon
Na, to norinog taddot mgo Pariseo no waa nokotavak iddos mgo Saduseo ki Disas, id porumannoy ran nid undiyot kandin.
Sokkad kandan no oray'd kotuig no tohodnonaw to mgo Suhu ni Moises, id geddam ki Disas ukit to kod-intud.
Kahi rin to, “Tohodnonaw, diyot langun no Suhu ni Moises, ingkon musing tadda kos lampas to langun kos koru-anon?”
Mid tavak si Disas to,

content.text: “ ‘Ginowanniyu kos Monama nod Longaggon du riyot tivuk no pusung du, diyot tivuk no umuu ru woy riyot tivuk no poomdom du.’

content: Ini en kos suhu no lampas to langun kos koru-anon.
Woy iddos iko-oruwon suhu no lampas to langun kos koru-anon, idda en so, ‘Ginowanniyu kos duma iling to kodginawa ru to ko-ugolingun du.’
Ka-ay en pantok to oruwon suhu, id pomon iddos langun no suhu no id boggoy to Monama ki Moises woy dos langun no id sulat to mgo propeta.”
Dos Intud Moka-atag to Mesiyas
To nolivuung pa iddos mgo Pariseo, mid intud si Disas kandan, kahi rin to,
“Ondan kos poomdom dow moka-atag to Mesiyas? Ondoy man kos kovuyyahan din?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Lubbad sikandin ni David.”
Kahin Disas to, “Ko ungketen, mambo man to id ngoranan sikandin ni David no ‘Longaggon’? Oyya su iddot no-iroomman si David to Uhis no Ispiritu, id ooseng sikandin to,

content.text: ‘Mid ikahi iddos Monama riyon tod Longaggon ku no,
Unsad ka lomig to kowanan ku taman tod kotalu kud iddos od pongkuntra kikow.’

content: Na, su id ngoranan man sikandin ni David no ‘Longaggon,’ momonnu vo no lubbad ni David iddos Mesiyas?”
Waa en nokotavak taddot intud ni Disas, ahad songo-kahi. Nopongnga idda, worad sikandan noko-aku nid intud kandin.
